title: asset_angle_variants status lifecycle

title: Style change does not propagate to project_assets.visual_style_capsule_id

entrypoint: Style lock after change (CAP-18)
precondition: Assets exist with stored capsule id
side_effects: Regenerate uses old style; new style applies only to new assets or those whose capsule is null
notes: generate-image uses asset capsule else Stage 5 manual tone only (projectAssets.ts:1244-1260), so if asset capsule is null and Stage 5 is now capsule-based, createImageJob throws. Sync-from-global can overwrite capsule id (projectAssets.ts:2209-2216).

title: Clear all images preserves attempts

side_effects: Carousel still shows selected attempt; storage objects kept
preserves: attempts, storage objects, angle variants, location view images
notes: Selected attempt cannot be deleted; reselect is possible via carousel but image_key_url is null until select.

title: Merge cascades and FK nulling on absorbed assets

entrypoint: POST merge
side_effects: Location camera_direction_id on shots SET NULL via location_views cascade
invalidates: Absorbed attempts, variants, views, location links
preserves: Survivor's own data; storage objects of absorbed remain
notes: Absorbed images are dropped from DB but storage objects remain; MergeDialog warns about lost images.

title: Deleting a location view deletes the image object in shared asset-images bucket

side_effects: Frame image storage object removed while frames row still references it
notes: Inferred from path parsing projectAssets.ts:3157-3162 and frame storage in same bucket (ImageGenerationService.ts:378-384). Runtime impact UNKNOWN.

title: Edit and regenerate results become the selected master image before Accept
summary: Each edit-image job is a master_asset job with assetId, so on success it creates a selected attempt and updates image_key_url. Cancel in the modal does not revert it.
entrypoint: EnhancedUploadModal action buttons
side_effects: Gate and card image change; previous selected attempt deselected; cap may delete oldest non-selected attempt
notes: Accept only saves description and selects the matching attempt if different.

title: Global sync overwrites project edits to linked fields

entrypoint: POST sync-from-global, Sync Available
side_effects: Project edits lost; localized image replaces project image without attempt row
notes: Contradicts migration 009 comment stating overridden fields should not be overwritten during global syncs.

title: Attempt cap of 4 deletes oldest non-selected attempt
summary: Before each new selected attempt (generate, upload, edit), if count is 4 or more, the oldest non-selected attempt row and its storage object are deleted. Originals uploaded by users can be pruned.

side_effects: Storage object deleted; carousel entry gone
notes: enforceAttemptCap runs before insert so the total can momentarily be 4 after insert (projectAssetAttemptsService.ts:170-197).

side_effects: Stale angle and view images remain used by frame prompts
notes: Downstream live joins read current image_key_url (cross-slice routes/projects.ts:3653-3659).
